body: Merged upstream/main to resolve the setup.rs / setup_delete.rs conflicts (kept both `hole` and #2015's `material` in StockSnap). Quick gate green.
The conflicts label was not true. The PR head fe9513aee now merges cleanly with origin/main a8bb30f0c. `git merge-tree` finds no conflict. I removed the label. The author re-checks at merge time.

Two reviews name this head. The review dated 2026-11-18T04:50Z came from an interrupted review run and missed the released-format facts. The later review (2026-11-18T05:00Z) is the complete one: it verified #1610 in tags v0.21.0 to v0.23.0 and the message regression for those files. Use the later review. This note does not change the verdict.

Hi @infield - this PR has waited about 32 hours on the review findings above, so (as the project rules allow for an idle needs-rework PR) a mkinney agent now fixes those findings on your branch: it pushes plain commits (no rebase, no force-push) and keeps your authorship of the original work. You can still take it back at any time - just comment here and we stop. Thank you for the fix!

I converted this pull request to draft before pushing the review fixes, and pushed commit `73a4caca9472fc358d3b9b41f44aa6ea80e7d4dd`.

1. **Keep the hole words for `v0.21.0` to `v0.24.0` files:** `model_fidelity::adopt_copies` in `crates/app/src/model_fidelity.rs` now heals a `FromModel` stock copy marked `fidelity_unknown` without its own hole from its live source on load, so deleting the source later keeps the hole and re-saving writes it. `model_fidelity::coarse_source` also falls back to `hole_behind` once when an unhealed copy has no hole. Pinned by `a_v021_to_v024_copy_without_its_own_hole_keeps_naming_its_sources_hole` in `crates/app/tests/stock_copy_hole.rs` (checked RED when reverted, GREEN when restored).
2. **Correct the format claim and mark the breaking change:** Updated `docs/decisions/1700-stock-copy-hole.md`, the PR title (`fix(fidelity)!: ...`), the PR body, and the new commit (`fix(fidelity)!:` and `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer) to record that `#1610` shipped in `v0.21.0` to `v0.24.0` and that those releases refuse `mesh_open` on a stock row as corrupt. Kept `PROJECT_VERSION` unbumped at `67` on this branch (`upstream/main` is already `v71`) to avoid conflicts on `file.rs` and `apply.rs`, and recorded that decision in `docs/decisions/1700-stock-copy-hole.md`.
3. **Add `Changelog:` line:** Added the `Changelog:` line to the PR body.

Checks after the final edit: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed (`126` steps, `0` failed) and `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed with no warnings.

Please re-review at head `73a4caca9472fc358d3b9b41f44aa6ea80e7d4dd`.

Correction to the previous comment: `gh pr edit` failed with GitHub's `repository.pullRequest.projectCards` GraphQL deprecation error, so the PR title and PR body on GitHub were **not** updated by this agent (`73a4caca9472fc358d3b9b41f44aa6ea80e7d4dd` on the branch has the `fix(fidelity)!:` subject, `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer, and updated `docs/decisions/1700-stock-copy-hole.md`, and `gh api` edits are blocked by local tool policy).

Please update the PR title and body manually before re-review:

- **Title:** `fix(fidelity)!: a stock copy of an incomplete model keeps naming its hole`
- **Project-file correction:** `#1610` (`35b3422cf`) shipped in `v0.21.0` through `v0.24.0`, so files carrying `mesh_open` on a `FromModel` stock row do not open in `v0.21.0` to `v0.24.0` (`validate.rs` refuses them as corrupt).
- **Breaking marker:** `BREAKING CHANGE: Project files that carry mesh_open on a FromModel stock copy are refused as corrupt by v0.21.0 to v0.24.0 readers.`
- **Changelog line:** `Changelog: Stock copies of incomplete models now keep naming their source model's hole after the source is deleted, and keep naming the hole for projects saved in v0.21.0 to v0.24.0.`

Needs changes before merge. The code checks pass. Two requests from the previous review remain open in the PR body.

The loader now copies the source hole into an older stock copy that has only the unknown-fidelity mark. The new test checks loading, refusal text, source deletion, and saving. The fallback also handles an in-memory copy without its own hole. The decision file corrects the release history. Commit 73a4caca9 has both a breaking subject and a BREAKING CHANGE footer.

I reviewed the laws from current upstream/main, not the PR branch. I built locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2024`, after a clean trial merge with upstream/main `49501a9b9e57c15aa3b9f6f1ba9a6e8c3180ce05`. No GitHub runner ran.

Requested before merge:

1. **PR body:16:** Correct the statement that the strict reader check has not shipped. It shipped in v0.21.0 through v0.24.0. Those readers reject a stock row with `mesh_open`. The merged writer uses project version 71, which those releases reject as unsupported. Make the body agree with `docs/decisions/1700-stock-copy-hole.md:23`. The current commit already supplies the required breaking marker. Also update the test count at body line 22 from six to seven.
2. **PR body:37 (end):** Add the required `Changelog:` line with the behavior change. A proposed line in a comment does not satisfy the requirement for the PR body. Keep the closing `Fixes #1700` line at the end.

This change preserves the refusal decisions and changes the stored hole details and diagnostic text. It changes no posted G-code, geometry, collision or gouge calculation, or stock simulation. Safety-tier mutations do not apply. I ran no mutations and changed no code. No goldens moved. No crates/ui files changed, so screenshots do not apply.

The previous code finding is met. The format correction is met in the decision file and commit, but remains incorrect in the PR body. The Changelog request remains unmet. I retain `needs-rework`. The PR author is infield; I leave the draft state unchanged.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
